PowerOneLineOne: Provided there are no obstacles that threaten your safety you're able to
PowerOneLineTwo: hand yourself over to whatever cosmic force is guiding you. This will cause
PowerOneLineThree: you to develop a sharper sense of where it wants you to go and have some
PowerOneLineFour: idea of how you can best get there.
PowerTwoLineOne: Restore the Hit-Points of all allies to max, or and one wound of a human. This
PowerTwoLineTwo: also applies to yourself and your own Digimon. This can only be used Once
PowerThreeLineOne: Whereever you currently are, you can ground yourself in the nearest point
PowerThreeLineTwo: of the Digital world that sees regular Tamer activity. This lets you quickly
PowerThreeLineThree: between worlds. If you're in the Digital World this instead brings someone
PowerThreeLineFour: of your choice to a location near yours.
PowerFourLineOne: Once per day you can create an illusion of yourself in one of the planes
PowerFourLineTwo: of reality you do not currently occupy. You cannot be harmed by, nor interact
